purpose: Small independent-label extraction pilot, not a semantic validator or superiority study.

selection.order: Original article, paragraph, question order. Select using question text only, before looking at labels or outcomes.

extractors.w2: First numeric token in the sentence with greatest unique lowercase alphabetic question-token overlap; tokens have at least three letters, fixed stop words, stable first-sentence tie break. No labels or other answers are provided.

access: Every arm receives identical eligible proposals from the two frozen source-only extractors. Gold labels are evaluator-only. Both workers read the same source, so their agreement is not independent evidence.
scoring: Best normalized answer agreement across the supplied answers. Empty predictions score against empty gold for unanswerable questions. Conflict and unsupported statuses remain separately reported; they are not collapsed into an intentional abstention claim.
falsifier: No candidate advantage over normalized union is expected: their eligible-cell value selection is extensionally the same. Any apparent advantage requires a scorer/input-parity investigation.
ceilings: 32 selected development questions, not a representative or confirmatory holdout
answer agreement is not factual truth or general entailment
no model inference or new human evaluation
data stays outside the repository pending owner rights/publication review
